version.changelog:
- Initial release of the software-dev-payload skill.
- Provides a high-density, highly iterative, standardized task system for software development across 12 subdomains and 320 tasks.
- Supports the full software lifecycle including requirements, architecture, coding, quality, testing, deployment, operations, security, efficiency, project management, documentation, and collaboration.
- Features a structured approach: subdomain catalog, task requirements, and example templates.
- Designed for compatibility with Meta Skill System’s execution framework and pipeline orchestration.

llm.summary: This is a Markdown-only software-development planning skill with no hidden execution or credential-handling behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The skill broadly covers coding, deployment, operations, security testing, and key-management task templates, which can be high-impact if applied to real systems, but those capabilities match its stated software-development lifecycle purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to read catalog and reference Markdown files and use task checklists; they do not request hidden behavior, system-prompt override, automatic execution, or unrelated data access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown files and metadata; no executable scripts, package hooks, binaries, or install-time commands were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request broad local indexing, browser/session access, credentials, network exfiltration, or privileged environment access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, scheduled task, privilege escalation, or auth/session-store use is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is reasonable to install as a software-development task catalog. Because it includes deployment, database migration, security testing, and key-management templates, review any generated commands or configuration before applying them to production systems or secrets.
